rows.title: DONE — P16 settled: retroactive drama estimation SHIPPED 2026-07-02 as the drama backfill, and was tuned after shipping (settled 2026-09-10)
rows.content:
Spec pushed: field-relay-nba docs/CC-CMD-2026-07-13-p15b-archive-catchup-fix.md (commit d83f785). Closes P15B, open since 2026-06-20. Confirmed via workers_get_worker_code (deployed bundle, not GitHub source -- read_source came back zero hits for both "journalism" and "morning brief already ran" despite both being genuinely live, same blind-spot pattern as the earlier journalism-endpoint near-miss; cross-verified via the bundle instead). Bug confirmed structurally identical to original June 20 diagnosis: morning-brief guard at line ~39447 precedes catch-up code at ~39596 in the same handleJournalismCycle function, both inside a conditional isMorningWindow block (11:00-13:00 UTC). Bounded impact, not total failure -- next tick outside the window catches up. One-liner sent.

P16 (retroactive drama estimation) confirmed still genuinely unbuilt, correctly ranked lowest priority (6th of 6) in the original June 20 health-monitoring table -- not dispatched, flagging as open for prioritization rather than assuming it should be picked up now.

getQualityTarget fully resolved: doesn't exist in current source at all, fully superseded by loadQualityCalibration() (analytics-cron KV first, D1 live percentile fallback). One real new gap found in the process: loadQualityCalibration's final catch(e){} is completely empty -- a D1 failure during fallback would silently leave calibration stale with zero telemetry. Not yet actioned, same class of gap as today's whole client-side sweep but on the relay side -- worth a small follow-up CC-CMD if/when relay-side telemetry work is prioritized.
